Marcus / Kim —

I've reviewed the numbers and cashflow impact. Finance can approve a structured exception for Stellar Data with the following controls:

- Approved discount schedule (annual prepay only): 18% Year 1 / 21% Year 2 / 24% Year 3.
- Requirement: Redwood issues an annual invoice that must be prepaid within 15 days. If Stellar fails to prepay, the invoice rate reverts to the standard published rate for that invoice period and discount is forfeited.
- Utilization true-up: We will include a true-up clause at the end of each year. If usage is >110% of committed, Stellar pays overage at the contracted unit rate. If usage <75% of committed, Redwood reserves the right to include a 6-month ramp support period before discount clawback (we want to avoid severe churn).
- Legal: standard SOW with an annual termination window and a DocuSign link for execution. No additional equity or credits.

This sits in the middle of Marcus's request and the standard grid. If AE needs anything tighter, that will need head of finance or CRO sign-off.
